summary: Esclarecimento feature v25 - All backend and frontend tests passed. 3 action buttons per ANVISA card working. Esclarecimento modal with company dropdown, text generation (Gemini AI), copy button, and PROVA DOCUMENTAL section all verified.

VERIFIED: ANVISA tab shows 3 buttons per card: Localizar Editais (blue bg-blue-600), Ver Prova Documental (amber bg-amber-500), Gerar Esclarecimento (purple bg-purple-600)

VERIFIED: Clicking 'Gerar Esclarecimento' opens modal with medicine info and company dropdown
